## Load data
```{r}
load("../Data/16S.Rdata")

taxa <- tax_table(phylo_all@tax_table) %>% as.matrix() %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "id")
taxa <- taxa %>% mutate(ASV = str_c("asv_", 1:nrow(taxa)),
                        Kingdom = str_replace_na(Kingdom,""), Kingdom = str_replace(Kingdom,"d__","k_"),
                        Phylum = str_replace_na(Phylum,""), Phylum = str_c("p_",Phylum),
                        Class = str_replace_na(Class,""), Class = str_c("c_",Class),
                        Order = str_replace_na(Order,""), Order = str_c("o_",Order),
                        Family = str_replace_na(Family,""), Family = str_c("f_",Family),
                        Genus = str_replace_na(Genus,""), Genus = str_c("g_",Genus),
                        Species = str_replace_na(Species,""), Species = str_c("s_",Species)) %>% 
# create long name for unclassified
  mutate(Class_l = case_when(Class == "c_" ~ str_c(Phylum, Class, sep = ";"),
                             TRUE ~ Class),
         Order_l = case_when(Order == "o_" ~ str_c(Class_l, Order, sep = ";"),
                             str_detect(Order, "uncultured") ~ str_c(Class_l, Order, sep = ";"),
                             TRUE ~ Order),
         Family_l = case_when(Family == "f_" ~ str_c(Order_l, Family, sep = ";"),
                              str_detect(Family, "uncultured") ~ str_c(Order_l, Family, sep = ";"),
                              TRUE ~ Family),
         Genus_l = case_when(Genus == "g_" ~ str_c(Family_l, Genus, sep = ";"),
                             str_detect(Genus, "uncultured|unidentified") ~ str_c(Family_l, Genus, sep = ";"),
                             str_detect(Genus, "A2|ASF356|DNF") ~ str_c(Family_l, Genus, sep = ";"),
                             TRUE ~ Genus),
         Species_l = case_when(Species == "s_" ~ str_c(Genus_l, Species, sep = ";"),
                               str_detect(Species, "uncultured|metagenome|unidentified") ~ str_c(Genus_l, Species, sep = ";"),
                               str_detect(Species, "mouse_gut|human_gut") ~ str_c(Genus_l, Species, sep = ";"),
                               TRUE ~ Species))

```

## Sample and subjects
```{r}
dat1 <- meta |> dplyr::count(Facility, Week, Treatment, Sex) |> 
  dplyr::rename(N_subject = n)

dat2 <- meta |> select(FamilyID, Facility, Week, Treatment, Sex) |> 
  unique() |> dplyr::count(Facility, Week, Treatment, Sex) |> 
  dplyr::rename(N_family = n)

tab <- dat1 |> left_join(dat2, by = c("Facility","Week","Treatment", "Sex")) |> 
  mutate(N = str_c(N_subject, "(", N_family, ")"))

tab |> pivot_wider(id_cols = "Week", names_from = c(Facility, Treatment, Sex), values_from = N)
```


## Beta diversity
```{r}
i = "bray"
week = "Week 3"
water = "Diwater"
house = "Vivarium"
s = "Male"
nperm <- 999
out <- "../Result/16S/beta/"
if (!dir.exists(out)) {
  dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

### PERMANOVA with interaction
```{r}
perms = list(family = family_permutations(meta, nperm),
             sex = sex_permutations(meta, nperm),
             time = time_permutations(meta, nperm))

res <- list()
diagnostics <- list()

for (i in c("bray", "jaccard")) {
  wdist <- get(paste0("dm_", i))
  ids <- intersect(rownames(as.matrix(wdist)), meta$SampleID)
  wdist <- dist_subset(wdist, ids)
  
  main_rhs <- "Week + Facility + Sex + Treatment"
  res[[paste0(i, "main_family")]] <- test_terms(wdist, meta, metric = i,
                                                rhs = main_rhs, perm = perms$family,
                                                wanted = c("Facility", "Treatment"), 
                                                analysis = "additive_main_effect",  
                                                scheme = "intact_family_blocks")
  
  res[[paste0(i, "main_sex")]] <- test_terms(wdist, meta, metric = i,
                                                  rhs = main_rhs, perms$sex,
                                                  wanted = "Sex", 
                                                  analysis = "additive_main_effect", 
                                                  scheme = "sex_trajectories_within_family")
  
  res[[paste0(i, "main_time")]] <- test_terms(wdist, meta, metric = i,
                                                   rhs = "Week + Condition(SubjectID)", perm = perms$time,
                                                   wanted = "Week", 
                                                   analysis = "within_subject_main_effect", 
                                                   scheme =  "synchronized_visits_within_family")
  
  rhs <- "(Week + Facility + Sex + Treatment)^2"
  res[[paste0(i, "between_interactions")]] <- test_terms(wdist, meta, metric = i,
                                                              rhs = rhs, perm = perms$family,
                                                              wanted = c("Facility:Sex", "Facility:Treatment", "Sex:Treatment"), 
                                                              analysi = "two_way_interaction", 
                                                              scheme = "intact_family_blocks")
  
  rhs_time <- "Week + Week:Facility + Week:Sex + Week:Treatment + Condition(SubjectID)"
  res[[paste0(i, "time_interactions")]] <- test_terms(wdist, meta,  metric = i,
                                                           rhs = rhs_time, perm = perms$time,
                                                           wanted = c("Week:Facility", "Week:Sex", "Week:Treatment"), 
                                                           analysis = "within_subject_two_way_interaction", 
                                                           scheme = "synchronized_visits_within_family")

  # Dispersion is assessed separately at each visit, preserving family structure.
  for (week in levels(meta$Week)) {
    wmeta <- meta |> filter(Week == week)
    wwdist <- dist_subset(wdist, wmeta$SampleID)
    pp <- family_permutations(wmeta, nperm)
    for (fac in c("Facility", "Treatment")) {
      bd <- betadisper(wwdist, wmeta[[fac]], type = "median", bias.adjust = T)
      a <- permutest(bd, permutations = pp)$tab
      diagnostics[[paste(i, week, fac)]] <- tibble(metric = i, Week = week, factor = fac,
        F = a[1,"F"], p = a[1,"Pr(>F)"], n_samples = nrow(wmeta))
    }
  }
}

permanova_results <- bind_rows(res) |> mutate(test_family = case_when(
  str_detect(analysis, "main_effect") ~ "main_effects_across_two_metrics",
  str_detect(analysis, "two_way") ~ "two_way_interactions_across_two_metrics",
  TRUE ~ "exploratory_higher_order_across_two_metrics")) |>
  group_by(test_family) |> mutate(q_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH")) |> ungroup()

write.csv(permanova_results, paste0(out, "PERMANOVA_main_interactions.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(diagnostics) |> mutate(q_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH")), paste0(out, "beta_dispersion.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

```

### PERMANOVA test for subgroups
```{r}
subres <- list()
for (i in c("bray", "jaccard")) { 
  wdist <- get(paste0("dm_", i))
  for (week in levels(meta$Week)) {
    for (target in c("Facility", "Treatment", "Sex")) {
      by_factors <- setdiff(c("Facility", "Treatment", "Sex"), target)
      groups <- meta |> filter(Week == week) |> group_by(across(all_of(by_factors))) |> group_split()
      for (wmeta in groups) {
        wmeta <- droplevels(wmeta)
        if (n_distinct(wmeta[[target]]) < 2) next
        ids <- intersect(rownames(as.matrix(wdist)), wmeta$SampleID)
        wwdist <- dist_subset(wdist, ids)
        pp <- if (target == "Sex") sex_permutations(wmeta, nperm) else family_permutations(wmeta, nperm)
        a <- test_terms(wwdist, wmeta, metric = i,
                        rhs = target, perm = pp, wanted = target, 
                        analysis = "stratified_comparison",
                        scheme = ifelse(target == "Sex", "within_family_sex_swap", "intact_family_blocks"))
        a$Week <- week
        a$stratum <- paste(paste(by_factors, vapply(by_factors, function(f) as.character(wmeta[[f]][1]), character(1)), sep = "="), collapse = ";")
        subres[[length(subres) + 1]] <- a
      }
    }
  }
}

permanova_subgroup <- bind_rows(subres) |> group_by(term) |>
  mutate(q_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH")) |> ungroup()

## combine sex
subres2 <- list()
for (i in c("bray", "jaccard")) { 
  wdist <- get(paste0("dm_", i))
  for (week in levels(meta$Week)) {
    for (target in c("Facility", "Treatment")) {
      by_factors <- setdiff(c("Facility", "Treatment"), target)
      groups <- meta |> filter(Week == week) |> group_by(across(all_of(by_factors))) |> group_split()
      for (wmeta in groups) {
        wmeta <- droplevels(wmeta)
        if (n_distinct(wmeta[[target]]) < 2) next
        ids <- intersect(rownames(as.matrix(wdist)), wmeta$SampleID)
        wwdist <- dist_subset(wdist, ids)
        pp <- family_permutations(wmeta, nperm)
        a <- test_terms(wwdist, wmeta, metric = i,
                        rhs = target, perm = pp, wanted = target, 
                        analysis = "stratified_comparison",
                        scheme = "intact_family_blocks")
        a$Week <- week
        a$stratum <- paste(paste(by_factors, vapply(by_factors, function(f) as.character(wmeta[[f]][1]), character(1)), sep = "="), collapse = ";")
        subres2[[length(subres2) + 1]] <- a
      }
    }
  }
}

permanova_subgroup2 <- bind_rows(subres2) |> group_by(term) |>
  mutate(q_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH")) |> ungroup()

## only age subgroup
subres3 <- list()
for (i in c("bray", "jaccard")) { 
  wdist <- get(paste0("dm_", i))
  for (week in levels(meta$Week)) {
    wmeta <- meta |> filter(Week == week)
    ids <- intersect(rownames(as.matrix(wdist)), wmeta$SampleID)
    wwdist <- dist_subset(wdist, ids)
    pp <- family_permutations(wmeta, nperm)
    a <- test_terms(wwdist, wmeta, metric = i,
                    rhs = "Facility + Sex + Treatment", 
                    perm = pp, wanted = c("Facility", "Treatment"), 
                    analysis = "stratified_comparison",
                    scheme = "intact_family_blocks")
    a$Week <- week
    a$stratum <- ""
    subres3[[length(subres3) + 1]] <- a
    
    pp <- sex_permutations(wmeta, nperm)
    a <- test_terms(wwdist, wmeta, metric = i,
                    rhs = "Facility + Sex + Treatment", 
                    perm = pp, wanted = c("Sex"), 
                    analysis = "stratified_comparison",
                    scheme = "within_family_sex_swap")
    a$Week <- week
    a$stratum <- ""
    subres3[[length(subres3) + 1]] <- a     
  }
}

permanova_subgroup3 <- bind_rows(subres3) |> group_by(term) |>
  mutate(q_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH")) |> ungroup()

write.csv(rbind(permanova_subgroup,permanova_subgroup2, permanova_subgroup3) |> 
            dplyr::select(metric, Week, term, stratum, everything()) |> 
            arrange(metric, Week, term, stratum),
          paste0(out,"PERMANOVA_subgroups.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```


### Facility differences by water treatment, age, sex
```{r}
# by treatment + age
g_lst <- list()
for (i in c("bray", "jaccard")){
  wdist <- get(paste0("dm_", i))
  for(water in c("Diwater",  "Chlorinated")){
    for(week in c("Week 3", "Week 7", "Week 12")){
      wmeta <- meta %>% filter(Treatment == water , Week == week)
      ids <- intersect(rownames(as.matrix(wdist)), wmeta$SampleID)
      wwdist <- dist_subset(wdist, ids)
      wpcoa <- pcoa(wwdist)
      varPC1 <- round(wpcoa$values$Relative_eig[1]*100, 2)
      varPC2 <- round(wpcoa$values$Relative_eig[2]*100, 2)
      wdat <- merge(wpcoa$vectors[,1:2], meta, by.x = 0, by.y = "SampleID")
      
      a <- permanova_subgroup2 |> 
        filter(metric == i, Week == week, formula == "Facility") |> 
        filter(str_detect(stratum, water))
      
      g = ggplot(wdat, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, color = Facility)) + 
        geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 1) + 
        scale_color_manual(values = col_facility) +
        labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", varPC1, "%)"),
             y = paste0("PC2 (", varPC2, "%)"),
             title = paste(week, water, sep = " "),
             subtitle = bquote("padj="*.(sprintf("%.3f", a$q_BH))*"; "*R^2*"="*.(sprintf("%.3f",a$R2_total)))
        ) + 
        theme_bw() + theme_all
      g_lst[[i]][[water]][[week]] <- g
    }
  }
}

idx <- expand.grid(
  Week  = c("Week 3", "Week 7", "Week 12"),
  Treatment = c("Diwater",  "Chlorinated"),
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(idx)), function(j){
  g_lst[["bray"]][[idx$Treatment[j]]][[idx$Week[j]]]
})

save_fixed_panels(plots = plots,
                  filename = paste0(out, "PCoA_facility_by_treatment_age_bray.pdf"),
                  ncol = 3, panel_width = 2, panel_height = 2, unit = "in", shared_legend = TRUE)

# by treatment + age + sex
g_lst <- list()

for (i in c("bray", "jaccard")){
  wdist <- get(paste0("dm_", i))
  for(water in c("Diwater",  "Chlorinated")){
    for(week in c("Week 3", "Week 7", "Week 12")){
      for(s in c("Male", "Female")){
        wmeta <- meta %>% filter(Treatment == water , Week == week , Sex == s)
        ids <- intersect(rownames(as.matrix(wdist)), wmeta$SampleID)
        wwdist <- dist_subset(wdist, ids)
        wpcoa <- pcoa(wwdist)
        varPC1 <- round(wpcoa$values$Relative_eig[1]*100, 2)
        varPC2 <- round(wpcoa$values$Relative_eig[2]*100, 2)
        wdat <- merge(wpcoa$vectors[,1:2], meta, by.x = 0, by.y = "SampleID")
        
        a <- permanova_subgroup |> 
          filter(metric == i, Week == week, formula == "Facility") |> 
          filter(str_detect(stratum, water), str_detect(stratum, s))
        
        g = ggplot(wdat, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, color = Facility)) + 
          geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 1) + 
          scale_color_manual(values = col_facility) +
          labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", varPC1, "%)"),
               y = paste0("PC2 (", varPC2, "%)"),
               title = paste(week, water, s, sep = " "),
               subtitle = bquote("padj="*.(sprintf("%.3f", a$q_BH))*"; "*R^2*"="*.(sprintf("%.3f",a$R2_total)))
          ) + 
          theme_bw() + theme_all
        g_lst[[i]][[water]][[week]][[s]] <- g
      }
    }
  }
}

idx <- expand.grid(
  Week  = c("Week 3", "Week 7", "Week 12"),
  Sex = c("Male", "Female"),
  Treatment = c("Diwater",  "Chlorinated"),
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(idx)), function(j){
  g_lst[["bray"]][[idx$Treatment[j]]][[idx$Week[j]]][[idx$Sex[j]]]
})

save_fixed_panels(plots = plots,
                  filename = paste0(out, "PCoA_facility_by_treatment_age_sex_bray.pdf"),
                  ncol = 3, panel_width = 2, panel_height = 2, unit = "in", shared_legend = TRUE)
```

### Whole PCoA treatment, facility, age, sex
```{r}
for (i in c("bray", "jaccard")){
  wdist = get(paste0("dm_", i))
  ids <- intersect(rownames(as.matrix(wdist)), meta$SampleID)
  wwdist <- dist_subset(wdist, ids)
  wpcoa = pcoa(wwdist)
  varPC1 <- round(wpcoa$values$Relative_eig[1]*100, 2)
  varPC2 <- round(wpcoa$values$Relative_eig[2]*100, 2)
  wdat = merge(wpcoa$vectors[,1:2],meta, by.x = 0, by.y = "SampleID")
  
  a <- permanova_results |> 
    filter(metric == i, term %in% c("Facility", "Treatment", "Week", "Sex"))
  
  g1 = ggplot(wdat, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, color = Facility)) + 
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = col_facility) +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", varPC1, "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC2 (", varPC2, "%)"),
         title = "Facility",
         subtitle =  bquote("padj="*.(sprintf("%.3f", (a |> filter(term == "Facility") |> pull(q_BH))))*
                              "; "*R^2*" = "*.(sprintf("%.3f", (a |> filter(term == "Facility") |> pull(R2_total)))))) + 
    theme_bw() + theme_all + theme(legend.title = element_blank())

  g2 = ggplot(wdat, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, color = Treatment)) + 
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = col_treatment) +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", varPC1, "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC2 (", varPC2, "%)"),
         title = "Water Treatment",
         subtitle =  bquote("padj="*.(sprintf("%.3f", (a |> filter(term == "Treatment") |> pull(q_BH))))*
                              "; "*R^2*" = "*.(sprintf("%.3f",(a |> filter(term == "Treatment") |> pull(R2_total)))))) +
    theme_bw() + theme_all + theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
                                   plot.subtitle = element_text(size=8, hjust = 0.5),
                                   plot.title = element_text(size=10, face = "bold"))
  
  g3 = ggplot(wdat, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, color = Week)) + 
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = col_age) +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", varPC1, "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC2 (", varPC2, "%)"),
         title = "Age (weeks)",
         subtitle =  bquote("padj="*.(sprintf("%.3f", (a |> filter(term == "Week") |> pull(q_BH))))*
                              "; "*R^2*" = "*.(sprintf("%.3f",(a |> filter(term == "Week") |> pull(R2_total)))))) + 
    theme_bw() + theme_all + theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
                                   plot.subtitle = element_text(size=8, hjust = 0.5),
                                   plot.title = element_text(size=10, face = "bold"))
  
  save_fixed_panels(plots = list(g1, g2, g3),
    filename = paste0(out,"PCoA_whole_age-treatment-facility_",i,".pdf"),
    ncol = 3, panel_width = 2, panel_height = 2, unit = "in", shared_legend = FALSE
  )
}

```

```{r}
          filter(Treatment == water & Facility == house & Week == week)

          ) + 
          theme_bw() + theme_all
        g_lst[[i]][[house]][[water]][[week]] <- g

    }
  }

               g_lst[["bray"]][["Farm"]][["Chlorinated"]][["Week 12"]]),
```

### LMM for alpha diversity
```{r}
emm_sum <- data.frame()
anova_sum <- data.frame()

for(i in c("faith_pd","observed_ASVs","pielou_evenness","shannon_index")){
  fo <- as.formula(paste0(i, " ~ Week*Facility + Week*Sex + Week*Treatment + (1 | SubjectID)"))
  fit <- lmer(formula = fo, data = meta)
  
  anova_results <- anova(fit, type = 3) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Term") |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Term,
      SumSq = `Sum Sq`,
      MeanSq = `Mean Sq`,
      NumDF,
      DenDF,
      Fvalue = `F value`,
      p.value = `Pr(>F)`,
      eta2p = (Fvalue * NumDF) / (Fvalue * NumDF + DenDF)
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
      across(c(SumSq, MeanSq, Fvalue, p.value, p.adj, eta2p),
             ~ round(.x, 3)),
      Metric = i,
      Term = stringr::str_replace(Term, "Week", "Age")
    )
  
  anova_sum <- rbind(anova_sum, anova_results)
  
  fac <- emmeans(fit, ~ Facility | Week) |> 
    pairs(adjust = "none") |> 
    as.data.frame() |> mutate(Variable = "Facility")
  
  trt <- emmeans(fit, ~ Treatment | Week) |> 
    pairs(adjust = "none") |> 
    as.data.frame() |> mutate(Variable = "Treatment")
  
  sex <- emmeans(fit, ~ Sex | Week) |> 
    pairs(adjust = "none") |> 
    as.data.frame() |> mutate(Variable = "Sex")
  
  age <- emmeans(fit, ~ Week) |> 
    pairs(adjust = "none") |> 
    as.data.frame() |> mutate(Variable = "Age", Week = "All") |> 
    dplyr::select(contrast, Week, everything())
    
  emm_results <- bind_rows(fac, trt, sex, age) |> 
    group_by((Variable)) |> 
    mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    select(Variable, Week, contrast, estimate, SE, df,
           t.ratio, p.value, p.adj) |> 
    mutate(across(c(estimate, SE, t.ratio, p.value, p.adj), ~ round(.x, 3))) |> 
    mutate(Metric = i)
  
  emm_sum <- rbind(emm_sum, emm_results)
}

write.csv(anova_sum |> select(Metric, everything()), 
          row.names = F, quote = F,
          file = paste0(out, "Alpha_LMM_anova.csv"))

write.csv(emm_sum |> select(Metric, everything()), row.names = F, quote = F,
          file = paste0(out, "Alpha_LMM_emm_compare.csv"))


```

### Maaslin2 with interaction_terms
```{r}
wmeta <- meta |> 
  mutate(Week = as.character(Week),
         Treatment = as.character(Treatment),
         Facility = as.character(Facility))

X <- model.matrix(~ (Week + Facility + Sex + Treatment)^2, wmeta)[,-1,drop=F]
original_terms = colnames(X)
colnames(X) = make.names(colnames(X))
wmeta = cbind(wmeta, as.data.frame(X))
rownames(wmeta) <- NULL
fit = do_maaslin2(wmeta, sample_id = "SampleID", phylo_rf = phylo_rf, 
                  fixed = colnames(X), random = c("FamilyID"),
                  output = paste0(out, "maaslin2_all_longitudinal_interactions"),
                  ref = NULL
)

res <-  summarise_maaslin2(
  path = paste0(out, "maaslin2_all_longitudinal_interactions"), 
  group = "interaction", taxa = taxa) 

res <- res |> 
  mutate(taxa_name = case_when(level == "ASV" ~ str_c(Species_l, ";", ASV),
                               level == "Species" ~ Species_l,
                               level == "Genus" ~ Genus_l,
                               level == "Family" ~ Family_l)) |> 
  dplyr::select(level, taxa_name, metadata, value, coef, stderr, N, N.not.0, pval, qval, 
                feature, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species, ASV)

write.csv(res, file = paste0(out,"maaslin2_summary_pups_all_longitudinal_interactions.csv"), quote = F, row.names = F)
``` 

### Maaslin2 Facility difference Week stratified
```{r}
wmeta <- meta |> 
  mutate(Week = as.character(Week),

rownames(wmeta) <- NULL
for (water in c("Diwater",  "Chlorinated")){
  for (week in c("Week 3", "Week 7", "Week 12")) {
    wwmeta <- wmeta |> filter(Treatment == water, Week == week)
    fit <- do_maaslin2(wwmeta, sample_id = "SampleID", phylo_rf = phylo_rf,

                       ref = c("Facility,Vivarium"))

      path = paste0(out, "maaslin2_facility_", water, "_", week, "_adjusted_sex"), 
      group = paste0(week), taxa)

  }
}
```

### heatmap of all Facility differentiated taxa
```{r}
all_genus_di <- rbind(read_csv(paste0(out,'maaslin2_facility_Diwater_Week 3.csv')) |> mutate(Week = "Week 3"), 
                      read_csv(paste0(out,'maaslin2_facility_Diwater_Week 7.csv')) |> mutate(Week = "Week 7"), 
                      read_csv(paste0(out,'maaslin2_facility_Diwater_Week 12.csv')) |> mutate(Week = "Week 12")) |> 
  filter(metadata == "Facility") |> 
  mutate(Treatment = "Diwater")

all_genus_cl <- rbind(read_csv(paste0(out,'maaslin2_facility_Chlorinated_Week 3.csv')) |> mutate(Week = "Week 3"), 
                      read_csv(paste0(out,'maaslin2_facility_Chlorinated_Week 7.csv')) |> mutate(Week = "Week 7"), 
                      read_csv(paste0(out,'maaslin2_facility_Chlorinated_Week 12.csv')) |> mutate(Week = "Week 12")) |> 
  filter(metadata == "Facility") |> 
  mutate(Treatment = "Chlorinated")

for (ll in c("Genus","Family")){
  dat <- rbind(all_genus_di, all_genus_cl) |> filter(level == ll)
   
  dat_wide <- dat %>%
    select(feature, coef, Treatment, Week) %>%
    complete(feature, Treatment, Week) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = c(Treatment, Week),
      values_from = coef,
      names_sep = "_") |> 
    left_join(taxa |> transmute(feature = id, Family_l, Genus_l), 
              by = "feature") 
  if(ll == "Genus"){
    dat_wide <- dat_wide |> 
      mutate(taxa_string = Genus_l) 
  }else if(ll == "Family"){
    dat_wide <- dat_wide |> 
      mutate(taxa_string = Family_l)
  }
  dat_wide <- dat_wide |> 
    select(taxa_string, c("Diwater_Week 3","Diwater_Week 7", "Diwater_Week 12",),
           c("Chlorinated_Week 3","Chlorinated_Week 7","Chlorinated_Week 12"))
  
  mat <- dat_wide |> column_to_rownames(var = "taxa_string")
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0 
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  
  anno <- data.frame(
    Treatment = factor(
      str_extract(colnames(mat), "^[^_]+"),
      levels = c("Diwater", "Chlorinated")),
    Week = factor(
      str_extract(colnames(mat), "(?<=Week )\\d+"),
      levels = c("3", "7", "12"))
  )
  
  col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Treatment = anno$Treatment,
    col = list(Treatment = c(Diwater = "darkgreen", Chlorinated = "#ad61c6"))
  )
  col_fun = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-3, 0, 6), c("blue", "white", "red"))
  
  p <- Heatmap(
    mat,
    width = ncol(mat) * unit(8, "mm"), 
    height = nrow(mat) * unit(4, "mm"),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "MaAsLin2\nCoefficient",
                                at = c(-3, 0, 3, 6)),
    top_annotation = col_anno,
    row_order = rownames(mat),
    column_order = colnames(mat),
    column_split = anno$Treatment,
    col = col_fun,
    row_names_side = "left",
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(mat), gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)),
    column_names_side = "top",
    column_names_rot = 0,
    column_names_centered = TRUE,
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    column_labels = anno$Week,
  )
  
  p1 <- draw(p, merge_legends = TRUE, heatmap_legend_side = "right", 
             annotation_legend_side = "right")
  
  pdf(file = paste0(out,"Facility_different_heatmap_", ll ,".pdf"), bg = "white",
      width = ComplexHeatmap:::width(p1) %>% as.numeric()/25.4, 
      height = ComplexHeatmap:::height(p1) %>% as.numeric()/25.4, useDingbats = F)
  draw(p1)
  dev.off()

}

```
### individual taxa differentiated by facility
```{r}
gg <- c("g_Akkermansia", "g_Dubosiella", "g_Muribaculaceae", 
        "g_[Eubacterium]_fissicatena_group", "g_Corynebacterium", "g_Dorea", "g_Staphylococcus") |> sort()

phylo_g <- tax_glom(phylo_rf, taxrank = "Genus")
taxa_g <- phylo_g@tax_table@.Data

ids <- intersect(taxa |> filter(Genus_l %in% gg) |> pull(id),
                taxa_g |> rownames())

taxa_label <- taxa_g |> as.data.frame() |> rownames_to_column(var = "id") |> 
  filter(id %in% ids) |> left_join(taxa |> dplyr::select(id, Genus_l)) |> 
  mutate(taxa_l = ifelse(Genus_l == "g_[Eubacterium]_fissicatena_group", "g_[Eubacterium]\nfissicatena_group", Genus_l))

dat <- subset_taxa(phylo_g, Genus %in% taxa_label$Genus)|> psmelt() |> 
  transmute(readcount = Abundance, SampleID = Sample, id = OTU)|> 
  mutate(logCount = log10(readcount + 1)) |> 
  left_join(meta, by = "SampleID") |> 
  left_join(taxa_label, by = "id") |> 
  mutate(Trt_sex = str_c(Treatment, " ", Sex))

stat <- dat |> group_by(taxa_l, Week, Trt_sex) |> 
  wilcox_test(logCount ~ Facility) |> 
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") |> 
  add_xy_position(x = "Week") |> 
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) |>
  mutate(label = paste0("padj=", format.pval(p.adj, digits = 1, eps = 0.001)))

g <- ggplot(dat, aes(Week, logCount, fill = Facility, color = Facility)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitterdodge(0.3)) + 
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat, tip.length = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_facility, aesthetics = c("color", "fill")) + 
  labs(y = "log10Counts", x = NULL) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))) +
  facet_grid(taxa_l ~ Trt_sex, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() + theme_all
  
ggsave(file = paste0(out,"individual_genus_taxa_differentiated_by_facility.pdf"),
          plot = g, width = 12, height =  15, units = "in", dpi = 300, device = "pdf")

```
